function App() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [rawData, setRawData]                   = useState([]);
  const [provinces, setProvinces]               = useState([]);
  const [foodTypes, setFoodTypes]               = useState([]);
  const [selectedProvinces, setSelectedProvinces] = useState([]);
  const [selectedFoodType, setSelectedFoodType]   = useState('');
  const [dateRange, setDateRange]               = useState({ start: '2020-01', end: '2025-06' });
  const [filteredData, setFilteredData]         = useState([]);
  const [error, setError]                       = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('Loading sample data...');
    
    // Use sample data instead of fetching from StatsCan
    const data = SAMPLE_DATA;
    
    console.log('Sample data loaded, length:', data.length);
    console.log('Sample data:', data.slice(0, 3));

    const provs = [...new Set(data.map(d => d.province))];
    const types = [...new Set(data.map(d => d.type))];

    console.log('Provinces found:', provs);
    console.log('Food types found:', types);

    setRawData(data);
    setProvinces(provs);
    setFoodTypes(types);
    // default to first options so controls render immediately
    setSelectedProvinces([provs[0]]);
    setSelectedFoodType(types[0]);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('Filtering data with:', {
      selectedFoodType,
      selectedProvinces,
      dateRange,
      rawDataLength: rawData.length
    });
    
    if (!selectedFoodType || selectedProvinces.length === 0) {
      console.log('Missing required selections, skipping filter');
      return;
    }
    
    const fd = rawData.filter(d =>
      selectedProvinces.includes(d.province) &&
      d.type === selectedFoodType &&
      d.date >= dateRange.start &&
      d.date <= dateRange.end
    );
    
    console.log('Filtered data length:', fd.length);
    console.log('Sample filtered data:', fd.slice(0, 3));
    
    setFilteredData(fd);
  }, [rawData, selectedProvinces, selectedFoodType, dateRange]);

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="app">
        <h1>{t('title')}</h1>
        <p style={{ color: 'red' }}>Error loading data: {error}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="app">
      <h1>{t('title')}</h1>
      <LanguageSelector />

      <div className="control-panel">
        <Controls
          provinces={provinces}
          selectedProvinces={selectedProvinces}
          onChangeProvinces={setSelectedProvinces}
          foodTypes={foodTypes}
          selectedFoodType={selectedFoodType}
          onChangeFoodType={setSelectedFoodType}
          dateRange={dateRange}
          onChangeDateRange={setDateRange}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="chart-container">
        <LineChartComponent data={filteredData} provinces={selectedProvinces} />
      </div>
      <div className="chart-container">
        <BarChartComponent
          data={rawData}
          date={dateRange.end}
          province={selectedProvinces[0]}
          foodTypes={foodTypes}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default App;
